input.script:
local companies = tool('list_companies', {})
local domain_to_name = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  domain_to_name[string.lower(c.domain)] = c.name
end

local function call_with_retry(name, input, tries)
  local last_err
  for i = 1, (tries or 6) do
    local ok, res = pcall(tool, name, input)
    if ok then return res end
    last_err = res
  end
  error("tool " .. name .. " failed after retries: " .. tostring(last_err))
end

-- Fetch all contacts
local all = {}
local page = 1
while true do
  local r = call_with_retry('list_contacts', { page = page })
  for _, ct in ipairs(r.items) do all[#all + 1] = ct end
  if page >= r.total_pages then break end
  page = page + 1
end

local function valid_e164(p)
  return p ~= nil and string.match(p, '^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') ~= nil
end

local function to_e164(p)
  local digits = string.gsub(p, '%D', '')
  if #digits == 11 and string.sub(digits, 1, 1) == '1' then
    return '+' .. digits
  elseif #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits
  end
  return nil -- unknown shape, leave untouched
end

local phones_fixed, companies_filled = 0, 0
local updates = {}

for _, ct in ipairs(all) do
  local upd = { id = ct.id }
  local need = false

  -- Phone
  if ct.phone and not valid_e164(ct.phone) then
    local np = to_e164(ct.phone)
    if np and np ~= ct.phone then
      upd.phone = np
      need = true
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end
  end

  -- Company
  if (ct.company == nil or ct.company == '') and ct.email then
    local dom = string.lower(string.match(ct.email, '@(.+)$') or '')
    local name = domain_to_name[dom]
    if name then
      upd.company = name
      need = true
      companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    end
  end

  if need then updates[#updates + 1] = upd end
end

for _, u in ipairs(updates) do
  call_with_retry('update_contact', u)
end

return {
  total_contacts = #all,
  phones_fixed = phones_fixed,
  companies_filled = companies_filled,
  updates = updates,
}
